name: Somnium Space

summary.text: Somnium Space is a virtual-reality 'metaverse' platform whose founder and CEO Artur Sychov announced in April 2022 a planned 'Live Forever' mode that would record users' movements and conversations in VR and use the data to build an avatar that could keep talking after their death. Sychov said the idea was prompted by his father's terminal cancer diagnosis and that in 2022 he expected the technology within about five years.
